subject: Unexpected results with the sorting from layer_lines

messages.author: c1cb392dfeeacea0
messages.subject: Unexpected results with the sorting from layer_lines
parts:
Consider the following example, which produces the result I expect (4 parallel lines):

my.df = merge(data.frame(x=1:10), merge(data.frame(f1=c(1,3)), data.frame(f2=c(10,30)), all=True), all=True)
my.df <- transform(my.df, y = x + f1 + f2, f1=ordered(f1), f2=ordered(f2))
my.df %>% group_by(f2, f1) %>% arrange(x) %>% ggvis(x=~x, y=~y, stroke=~f1) %>% layer_paths()

If I replace the call to layer_paths() with layer_lines() on the last line, I get a bunch of zigzags. I don't know if that's the intended behavior of the built-in auto-sorting from layer_lines or if it's a bug, but the zigzags surely were unexpected for me.
